pro_course_detail.title: Arabic Language Course From Scratch
pro_course_detail.description:
Objectives:
These courses have been designed for those who wish to learn Arabic from scratch in the Basic Arabic Language Course. Successful students shall then progress to the Arabic beginner Course (A).
The Arabic language is easy to learn with Our interactive methods which  make learning enjoyable and rewarding.
Students will be able to understand in - sha - Allah the translation and the meaning of the Holy Quran while it is being recited in the prayers (As-Salah ) or elsewhere.
The learner will be able to communicate in modern Arabic with Arabic speaking individuals.
Students shall gain an additional language qualification.
Enhance reading skills.

pro_course_detail.title: ARABIC INTERMADIATE  COURSE
pro_course_detail.description:
Objectives:
These courses have been designed for those who wish to learn Arabic from Al Arabiyyah Bayna Yadayk Book  Two. 
In this book the student delves deeper into the linguistic structures and vocabularies, which  most commonly used in classical books and general intellectual subjects.
The learner will be able to  identify the sources of Arabic words and their derivatives by studying some Surf (Morphology) lessons
 

COURSE OUTLINE
Chapter 1: Healthcare
Chapter 2: Recreation
Chapter 3: Married Life
Chapter 4: City Life

pro_course_detail.title: ARABIC ADVANCED  COURSE
pro_course_detail.description:
Objectives:
These courses have been designed for those who wish to learn Arabic from Al Arabiyyah Bayna Yadayk Book  Four. 
Students will be able to understand and talk in - sha - Allah about the daily life actions like family, home, food and drink ..ect.
The learner will be able to communicate in modern Arabic with Arabic speaking individuals.
 

COURSE OUTLINE
Chapter 1: From the Dangers of Smoking
Chapter 2: Recreation
Chapter 3: Choose a Wife
 Chapter 4: Holy Cities
